Scope: (1) repaint bedroom and other rooms if needed; (2) replace burnt bedroom carpet; (3) replace bathroom flooring; (4) repair broken plug; (5) repair dripping bath tap; (6) repair damaged bathroom shelf. Please ask for an itemised price per item, with VAT stated. Attachments: attachment-01-check-out-inspection-report.pdf (also attachment-03 copy). Please reply by 2025-04-10 with the quote. Hello, thanks for your reply. We're getting a second quote from another contractor for the same works, itemised, and will hold the first estimate until then. We aim to come back to you by 10 April with both for comparison. No work will start until you've approved. If you already have a contractor you'd prefer us to ask, let us know.
